options.file:
# c1
pprof: {enable: false}
#   c2 with words
# c3
'client': {codex: {optimize-multi-agent-v2: true, "enable-apply-patch": false}}
# c4
meta-api-key: &m5 # c6
  - api-key: ' key-1 '
    # c7
    #   c8 with words
    proxy-url: socks5://user:pass@192.168.1.1:1080/path
    #c9
    headers: {X-Empty: "a"}
    # c10
    disable-cooling: true
    alpha-search: true

debug: true
"disable-image-generation": "no"
devin: &m11 #c12
  sensitive-words: #   c13 with words
    - 'internal name' # c14
    - acme #c15

error-logs-max-files: -2 # c16
payload:
  default:
    - 'models': #   c17 with words
        - name: >-
            *
        - name: "*" # c18
          #   c19 with words
          protocol: openai
      'params': #   c20 with words
        reasoning.effort: true
  default-raw:
    #   c21 with words
    - 'models':
        - name: "gpt-*"
          # c22
          protocol: claude
      # c23
      params: # c24
        generationConfig.thinkingConfig:
          #   c25 with words
          #c26
          nested: {deep: true} #   c27 with words
        # c28
    - models: #c29
        - {name: claude-sonnet-4-6}
        # c30
        - name: '*'
          protocol: &s31 'openai'
      'params':
        # c32
        tools.0.name: #   c33 with words
          'nested': {'deep': true} # c34
        max_output_tokens: 1.0

remote-management: {allow-remote: false, disable-control-panel: false, disable-auto-update-panel: false, secret-key: '$2a$10$abcdefghijklmnopqrstuv', panel-github-repository: "https://user:pass@panel.example/private?token=t", base-url: 'http://[fe80::1%25en0]:8080/x'} #c35
#   c36 with words
#c37
nonstream-keepalive-interval: 5
'api-keys': ['key-2', key-2, ' key-1 ', 'key-2'] #c38
# c39
oauth-request-scoped-errors:
  vertex: #c40
    - status: 400
      action: 'stop'
    - status: 0 # c41
      action: ''
# c42
    - status: 429
      "action": 'continue'
      match:
        #c43
        - |-
          claude-2*
        - "claude-2*" # c44

#   c45 with words
"auth-dir": '/tmp/auth'
#   c46 with words
oauth-settings:
  # c47
  # c48
  aistudio: #c49
    - name: m1
      alias: ' a1 '
      max-context-length: 272000 # c50
    #   c51 with words
    # c52
    - 'name': ''
      alias: &s53 a1
      max-context-length: 272000
    - 'name': gpt-6-sol
      alias: "Pro" #c54
      max-context-length: 200000 # c55
  #   c56 with words
xai: #   c57 with words
  inject-x-search: true
# c58
proxy-url: ' http://proxy.example:3128 '
# c59
transient-error-cooldown-seconds: 0

save-cooldown-status: true

plugins:
  enabled: false # c60
  'dir': 'ferry-plugins'
  # c61
  # c62
  configs:
    # c63
    alpha: &m64 #c65
      'settings':
        endpoint: "https://hook.example/run"
        #c66
        tags:
          #c67
          - &s68 "a"
          # c69
          # c70
          - &s71 'b c'
    # c72
    gamma:
      enabled: true

#c73
quota-exceeded: # c74
  antigravity-credits: true
